verdicts.decision_note: The client requests a 16-second Hindi visual preview as a concrete review artifact before proceeding, defining its duration, language, and approval purpose.
This is the first target-specific delivery claim: the freelancer reports attaching the visual-and-voiceover preview for client review.
The delivered preview concretely misses the 16-second acceptance condition by running for 22 seconds, adding a distinct failure alongside the delivery claim.
This is the first concrete verification of the review workflow: the client viewed the preview and authorized progression to full-video production despite separate creative-quality concerns.
